source.member: Healer.DoSkillCheck(Player healer, Player target, uint missingVital, ref int difficulty)
source.notes: ThreadSafeRandom seeded with new System.Random(seed) by reflection. in: current = the healer's Healing CreatureSkill.Current (ACE's); sac = its advancement class; boost = the kit's BoostValue (PropertyInt 90, null = unset); combat = the healer's CombatMode (int); missing = missingVital. out = [result, difficulty, ThreadSafeRandom.Next(0, 1000000) after the call].
